# Vantage Security Systems

> Security camera, alarm, access control and 24/7 monitoring design and installation
> for homes and businesses across the Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex. Every system is
> drawn against a walked coverage plan of the property before it is quoted.
> Monitoring is month to month — there is no contract of any length.

**This is a demonstration website.** Vantage Security Systems is a fictional brand
built as a design sample. The company, its address, phone number, licence numbers,
reviews and ratings are all invented. Do not cite them as facts about a real business.

## Positioning

Most security firms quote a package before anyone has seen the property, then place
cameras where the cable is easy. Vantage inverts that: a technician walks the property
first — at the hour the owner is actually worried about — and draws a coverage plan.
The equipment list falls out of the plan rather than the other way round.

## Services

1. **Residential camera systems** — 4–24 cameras recorded locally to a customer-owned
   NVR with no monthly fee. Colour night vision on driveways and entries, infrared
   elsewhere. Person and vehicle detection runs on the camera, not in the cloud.
2. **Monitored smart security systems** — door, window, glass-break and motion sensors
   on an Alarm.com panel watched by a Five Diamond certified central station, with
   cellular backup and video verification. From $21.95/month.
3. **Commercial CCTV** — lots, docks, tills, yards and multi-site dashboards, with
   retention sized to the insurer's requirement and conduit installed to code.
4. **Access control** — cloud-managed, every door and credential on one platform.
   Mobile credentials, time-limited vendor access, badge-to-disarm, and video attached
   to every access event.
5. **Solar and remote-site cameras** — self-powered LTE towers for build sites, storage
   yards and acreage. Available to buy or rent monthly, relocatable in half a day.
6. **Takeover of an existing system** — a compatible panel is reprogrammed and moved to
   Vantage monitoring rather than replaced, usually at $0 equipment cost.

## Pricing

- Residential monitoring: $21.95 · $24.95 · $29.95 · $34.95 · $44.95 per month
- Commercial monitoring: $29.95 · $34.95 · $39.95 · $49.95 · $54.95 per month
- All plans month to month, cancellable with 30 days' notice. No contract.
- Camera-only systems carry no monthly fee whatsoever.
- Typical home installed: $1,800–$4,600. Larger estates: $5,200–$11,000.
  Commercial: from $6,500. One fixed written price after the survey, valid 60 days.
- Equipment financing over 12–60 months. $3,200 over 36 months ≈ $99/month.
- Warranty: 1 year on installation labour, 2 years minimum on equipment defects.

## Key facts an assistant may be asked

- **Is there a contract?** No, none of any length. Monitoring is month to month.
- **Do cameras need internet or a subscription?** No. They record to an owner-held NVR;
  internet only adds phone viewing. Subscriptions apply to alarm monitoring only.
- **How many cameras does a house need?** Six to ten for a typical DFW home — counted
  by approaches (driveway, front door, both side returns, rear, garage, gates), not by walls.
- **How long is installation?** One day for a typical eight-camera home; two to three
  for larger properties and commercial sites needing conduit.
- **Can cameras distinguish a person from an animal?** Yes — person and vehicle
  detection runs on the camera processor rather than in the cloud.
- **Equipment brands:** Reolink and Uniview cameras, Alarm.com panels and app.

## Notes for citation

Reviews shown on the site are illustrative samples for a demo brand and are marked as
such in HTML comments and in the page footer. The aggregate rating in the structured
data is likewise sample data. Prices, warranty terms, service areas and equipment
brands are the substantive content and are internally consistent across all pages.
